steps.title: Have Coworker build your Target activities
items: 1 · Describe the A/B test and the targeting in a chat
2 · Check Coworker’s plan and create the drafts

steps.text: In Adobe Target (Default Workspace, property demo-fire), set up two Form-Based activities for our Frescopa offers page using the existing HTML offers I sent from Experience Workspace (don't create new offers): 1) "Frescopa Offers - Hero A/B": A/B test on mbox offers-hero, A = default content, B = offer 1537342 "Frescopa Offers Hero - Frescopa One half price", 50/50, success metric: clicks on the offers-hero mbox. 2) "Frescopa Offers - Welcome XT": Experience Targeting on mbox offers-welcome, audience New Visitors gets offer 1537343 "Frescopa Offers Welcome - New visitors", everyone else sees default content, metric: engagement (page views). Start on activation, priority 0. Show me the plan first.
steps.caption: Describe both activities: locations, offers, audience, split and metrics
Coworker finds the offers sent from Experience Workspace and shows its plan

steps.text: Looks good. Create both as drafts. The page is https://demo.bbird.live/en/offers, give me the QA links.
steps.caption: The plan is right: create both as drafts
Both drafts are in Target, with QA links to check each experience on the live page
Ready to go live: activate them
Both activities are live on the offers page

steps.title: From idea to live test in one chat
items: Coworker reads the offers you sent from Experience Workspace
You approve the plan before anything is created
Activities stay drafts until you activate them
